gaps.sentence: ___ she felt nervous, she delivered a flawless speech.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' introduces a full clause and is stronger than although.

gaps.sentence: ___ she was utterly exhausted, she stayed to help clear up.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' concedes a known fact: she was exhausted and still stayed.

gaps.sentence: ___ being the youngest competitor, she won the gold medal.
gaps.explanation: 'Despite being...' is the standard concessive pattern with a gerund.

gaps.sentence: Far from resenting the changes, the staff welcomed them; ___, productivity rose.
gaps.explanation: Rising productivity is an additional point in the same direction: moreover.

gaps.sentence: She took a map ___ she wouldn't get lost.
___ it rains all weekend, the ceremony will still be held outdoors.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a possible (not yet real) condition.

gaps.sentence: He had hardly stepped off the plane ___ he was rushed into a meeting.
The old system charged per download, ___ the new one uses a flat monthly fee.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' sets the old and new systems side by side.
